newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Al-Ahli Bank shares seen up at 350-360 fils.
newsitem.headline: Al-Ahli Bank shares seen up at 350-360 fils.

text.p: Al-Ahli Commercial Bank's share price could rise by up to 10 percent in the next six to nine months, investment and merchant bank Taib Bank said in a research report on Sunday.
"Given sound fundamentals and cheap share profile, we believe that Al-Ahli has potential to appreciate over the next six to nine months to around 350-360 fils," the report said.
Al-Ahli shares were trading on Sunday at 326 fils.

The report described the bank as one of the fastest growing banks in Bahrain in terms of branch network, client base and market share. It also said it was the most liquid share on the Bahrain stock exchange.
Taib said a total of 26.4 million shares of Al-Ahli worth 7.4 million dinars ($19.6 million) changed hands in 1996.
Al-Ahli, Bahrain's third largest bank, last week announced a first quarter net profit of 1.46 million dinars, up from 1.39 million in the first three months of 1996.
